preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 200000 and k == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and (n, k) := map(int, line.split()))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line contains two integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200000) and k (k=2).

preconditions.expression: sum(int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 200000.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == str(y) and 0 <= y <= 20000000 for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Every query output is a single integer y (0 ≤ y ≤ 20000000).

postconditions.expression: all(r == 1 or r == 0 or r == -1 for r in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line not in [stdin.splitlines()[0]] and line not in [line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0')]] if line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each query, the response r is either 1 (correct guess), 0 (incorrect guess), or -1 (invalid query).

postconditions.expression: all(r == 1 for r in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line not in [stdin.splitlines()[0]] and line not in [line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0')]] if line.strip() and line.split()[0] == '1')
postconditions.description: If a query y matches the current password x, the response r is 1, and the test case is solved.

postconditions.expression: all(r == 0 for r in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line not in [stdin.splitlines()[0]] and line not in [line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0')]] if line.strip() and line.split()[0] == '0')
postconditions.description: If a query y does not match the current password x, the response r is 0, and the password changes to z such that x XOR z = y.

postconditions.expression: all(r == -1 for r in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line not in [stdin.splitlines()[0]] and line not in [line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0')]] if line.strip() and line.split()[0] == '-1')
postconditions.description: If an invalid query is made or the number of queries exceeds n, the response r is -1.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) <= sum(int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()) for _ in range(t))
postconditions.description: The total number of queries across all test cases does not exceed the sum of n for each test case.
